newsitem.title: USA: CNA names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: CNA names chief financial officer.

text.p: CNA Fiancial Corp said Wednesday it named W. James MacGinnitie as chief financial officer and senior vice president.
He replaces Peter Jokiel, who was promoted to president of its CNA Life subsidiary in April, 1997.
MacGinnitie comes to CNA from Ernst & Young LLP where he has been a partner and national director of actuarial services since 1994.

CNA said MacGinnitie plans to begin acquainting himself immediately with CNA while completing client assignments at Ernst & Young LLP. He will assume his new position on a full time basis on October 1.
CNA, an insurance company, had 1996 revenues of $17.0 billion.
